modalities.evidence: This dataset contains un-processed MRI data

output.population: 24 female adult Wistar rats, healthy/control, anesthetized with medetomidine
output.summary: Unprocessed anatomical and BOLD fMRI scans from 24 female adult Wistar rats anesthetized with medetomidine for up to six hours, including electrical forepaw stimulation and resting-state runs acquired repeatedly over the anesthesia period.
